about: Every rename of the W3CSS Theme 3.0 release by kind. Rows with source rename-map come from the 2026-11-10 rename map; rows with source scheme-2x name the 2.x color scheme tokens. Edit this file, then run scripts/class-list.py to rewrite docs/CLASS-MIGRATION.md and docs/class-migration.html. handling: rewrite = the tool rewrites it; rewrite-yml = rewritten only with --yml; report = listed for a hand change; stored = saved by drush updb or --stored; unreleased = a 3.0-dev name that never shipped; none = nothing to do.
